endorsements.name: Chase Hatch
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25358
endorsements.description: FileOptimizer 14.00.2524 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by manipulating the FileOptimizer32.ini configuration file. Attackers can overwrite the TempDirectory parameter with a 5000-character buffer to cause the application to crash when opening options.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Chase Hatch
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25361
endorsements.description: Ayukov NFTP client 1.71 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the SYST command handling that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Attackers can send a specially crafted SYST command with oversized payload to trigger a buffer overflow and execute a bind shell on port 5150.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Chase Hatch
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25365
endorsements.description: ChaosPro 2.0 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the configuration file path handling that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by overwriting the Structured Exception Handler. Attackers can craft a malicious configuration file with carefully constructed payload to overwrite memory and gain remote code execution on vulnerable Windows XP systems.
